title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: With an innovation fund, the Programme Innovation Lab will foster innovation emerging from within GOAL’s programmes and promote these internally and with the wider development and humanitarian community. The Lab build on the success of GOAL's Resilience Innovation and Learning Hub (RILH), which is a priority innovation workstream within the broader Programme Innovation Lab and whci will serve as a model for other programme innovation priorities. The Lab will alo provide strategic guidance and support for innovative programming within GOAL, especially in relation to climate change adaptation and gender transformation.OBJECTIVES: Objective 3: Increased preparedness and response capacity against hazards which threaten people’s food and nutrition securityOUTCOMES: Outcome 3: People Have Food & Nutrition Security
